description:
About Us

Sway Vacation Rental Management is a boutique luxury short-term rental company based in Scottsdale, Arizona. We manage 40+ high-end vacation rental properties across the greater Phoenix metro area. We operate with high standards, a tight-knit team, and a strong systems-first culture. This is a long-term role with a stable, growing company.



Role Overview

We are hiring a full-time Maintenance Coordinator VA to work directly alongside our on-the-ground Maintenance Manager and report to the company founder. Your primary responsibility is to manage and balance our daily maintenance schedule in Breezeway — making sure tasks are assigned, prioritized, and completed on time across our entire property portfolio.



This is a highly detail-oriented, communication-heavy role. You will be the operational backbone of our maintenance department — keeping things organized, vendors accountable, and our team on track every single day.



Key Responsibilities

Open Breezeway each morning and audit all outstanding and upcoming maintenance tasks across the portfolio

Assign, reassign, and balance the daily workload for our full-time handyman and maintenance staff based on priority, location, and urgency

Communicate with our on-site Maintenance Manager throughout the day to coordinate scheduling and flag urgent issues

Follow up with vendors and contractors on open work orders to ensure timely completion

Track recurring maintenance tasks (pool service, pest control, landscaping, etc.) and ensure nothing falls through the cracks

Escalate urgent property issues to the appropriate tea
mber immediately

Maintain organized records of completed work, vendor contacts, and property-specific notes

Assist with guest-reported maintenance issues — documenting, triaging, and routing to the right person

Support the team with administrative tasks related to maintenance operations as needed



Requirements

Minimum 2 years of experience in a coordination, operations, or administrative role — property management or real estate experience strongly preferred

Comfortable working in Breezeway or a similar property/task management platform (training provided)

Excellent written and spoken English — you will communicate daily with US-based tea
mbers

Strong organizational skills and a proactive, detail-oriented mindset

Reliable high-speed internet connection and a quiet, dedicated work environment

Ability to work Monday–Friday, 7:00 AM – 3:00 PM Arizona Time (MST) — this schedule is firm

Self-starter who takes ownership, follows through, and doesn’t need to be micromanaged

Prior experience with Airbnb, VRBO, or short-term rental management

Familiarity with Google Workspace (Gmail, Sheets, Drive)

Experience coordinating with field technicians, contractors, or vendors



What We Offer

Full-time, stable long-term employment with a growing company

Competitive pay: $7–$9/hr USD based on experience (˜$1,120–$1,440/month)

13th-month bonus (paid in December) for strong performers

Consistent schedule 

A supportive team that invests in clear processes and good systems

Direct access to company leadership — your work matters and is noticed

Your updated resume

A 2–3 sentence summary of any property management, real estate, or maintenance coordination experience you have

title: Appointment Setter – AI Lead Gen for Home Services (Base + Commission)

If you've hit consistent daily activity targets, kept a clean CRM, and love the feeling of getting a prospect to say "yes, book me in" - keep reading. If you're looking to coast, this isn't your role.

An AI-powered lead generation system built for Home Services businesses (painters, remodelers, and similar trades). The system generates leads, qualifies them with AI voice + text agents, and books appointments directly on our clients' calendars. It works. We took one painter from $295K/year to $1.5M in 14 months. This is consistent, focused work. You'll be working warm inbound leads AND running outbound to home services business owners. Your one job: get qualified decision-makers on the calendar. A closer handles the rest. Most people don't have the discipline for this. The ones who do will earn well and grow with us.

- Work inbound leads fast - speed to lead is everything.

- Run outbound to home services business owners (phone + text + LinkedIn).

- Qualify prospects and book them onto the closer's calendar using GHL.

- Consistent and disciplined - you show up, dial, and hit targets without being chased.

- Phone confidence - comfortable starting conversations with business owners cold.

- Excellent written and spoken English

Uncapped commission. Base starting 30k-50k PHP/month + commission per closed deal that you set + residual recurring commission (Wise/Payoneer paid bi-weekly). Top setters double their base monthly when the closer converts. 13th month considered for long-term hires.

title: YouTube Growth Specialist (Part-Time)
description:
I run an education channel on AI governance and tech career transitions, tied to a webinar-driven coaching business. What You’ll Own

• SEO & optimization: titles, descriptions, tags, chapters, end screens, cards, and playlists built for discovery.

• Publishing strategy: cadence, timing, premieres, and a Shorts plan that feeds the main channel.

• Analytics & iteration: track retention, CTR, and traffic sources; report what’s working and adjust the plan.

• Audience growth: community tab, comment-engagement strategy, and audience research.



I create and record every video. Your job is to grow the channel around them.

What You Bring

• A track record of growing a YouTube channel; ideally with before/after metrics you can show.

• Deep knowledge of YouTube SEO and how the algorithm surfaces content (browse, suggested, search).

• Packaging skill: titles and thumbnails that earn clicks, backed by testing.

• Fluency in YouTube Studio analytics; retention, CTR, and traffic sources.

• Thumbnail design ability or strong art direction (Canva, Photoshop, or similar).

• Data-driven instincts; you test, read the numbers, and iterate.

• Strong written English for titles, descriptions, and metadata.

Nice to Have

• Experience growing an education, info, or expert-led channel.

• A professional or B2B audience.

• Shorts growth experience.



Logistics

• Part-time, long-term, with room to grow as the channel does.

• Overlap with US Central business hours.

• Begins with a paid trial project so we can both assess fit.



How to Apply

Send me:

1. A short intro and why YouTube growth is your thing.

2. A channel you’ve grown; with before/after numbers if you have them.

3. A few examples: thumbnails or titles you’ve made, or an optimization you’re proud of.

4. Your availability.



Shortlisted candidates complete a short paid trial task: I’ll share one of my videos and a snapshot of the channel, and you’ll send (a) a packaging concept; title and thumbnail; and (b) three specific growth recommendations with your reasoning. How you think about the channel matters more to me than a polished résumé.

Application Instructions



Put “DETAIL FIRST” in your application title.

Tell us about your dental experience

Why are you a strong fit for this role?

Why should a dental office outsource insurance work to us?



Complete the technical and sales assessments provided below.



Assessment Part 1 — Technical Dental Knowledge 

Scenario 1: In-Network Claim Analysis



A PPO office is in-network with Delta Dental.



A patient receives:



A patient receives the following services:



• Crown (D2740)

Office Fee: $1,400

Allowed Amount: $900



• Core Build-Up (D2950)

Office Fee: $350

Allowed Amount: $180



• Bitewings

Office Fee: $120

Allowed Amount: $60



Insurance pays 80% for restorative and 100% for diagnostics/preventive.

The patient has $250 remaining deductible, and deductible applies to restorative services.



Please answer:



How much will insurance pay for each service?

What is the contractual write-off for each service?

What is total patient responsibility?

If insurance underpaid, how would you verify the EOB?

Same services, but office is out-of-network with MetLife.



Allowed amounts remain the same.



Please answer:



Is there a contractual write-off? Why or why not?

What amount can the patient be balance billed?

How would you explain this to an upset patient?

A claim for scaling and root planing is denied with reason:

The office submitted X-rays but payment was denied.



Please answer:



What documents would you gather for appeal?

How would you structure the appeal?

This may be the most valuable section.



Objection Handling



A dental office says:

Respond as if you’re on a live sales call.

title: Marketing & Sales Support Specialist
description:
About ALPHA IT 



ALPHA IT is a Vancouver Island-based managed IT services provider headquartered in Courtenay, BC, Canada. We help local organizations stay secure, productive, and prepared for growth through practical IT strategy, cybersecurity, support, and Microsoft-focused solutions. 



Our growth focus today is trades, construction, mechanical, and field-service businesses across Vancouver Island, alongside long-standing relationships with First Nations, non-profits, and other local organizations that rely on technology to keep daily operations moving. 



We are also building out our AI solutions practice, including Microsoft Copilot, AI readiness assessments, and automation tools, with the goal of bringing practical, accessible AI support to local businesses. 



Role Summary 



ALPHA IT is looking for a remote Marketing & Sales Support Specialist to help keep our marketing engine moving. This role is focused on execution, production, coordination, and reporting support across content, SEO,
 marketing, website updates, social media, campaign assets, and sales enablement. 



The Director of Sales & Marketing, vCIO, and leadership team will own local relationships, events, and sales conversations. Your role is to support that work behind the scenes by preparing assets, organizing campaign details, updating systems, drafting content, reviewing performance, and helping the team move faster. 



The right person is organized, detail-oriented, proactive, comfortable with technology, and able to follow clear direction while also spotting ways to improve execution. Strong written English, reliable communication, and the ability to work independently are essential. 



Key Responsibilities 



This role touches a lot of areas — campaigns, website/SEO, sales support, events, and reporting. That's intentional: you'll get broad exposure to marketing and sales in a fast-moving local business, with the Director of Sales & Marketing setting priorities so you're never guessing what matters most this week. 



Marketing Campaigns & Lead Generation 



Support campaign execution across website,
, webinars, digital ads, and partner channels. 



Build, test, schedule, and report on
 campaigns using Mailchimp. 



Help prepare and QA campaign assets before launch, including copy drafts, checklists, links, tracking details, and basic reporting summaries.

 invitations, reminder
s, social posts, attendee tracking, and post-webinar assets. 



Help maintain lead-generation assets such as landing pages, checklists, whitepapers, scorecards, event offers, and follow-up campaigns. 



Support paid campaign coordination through reporting, landing page QA, ad copy drafts, keyword/competitor research, and lead-quality tracking. 



 



Website, SEO, Content & Social Media 



Coordinate website and landing page updates with our internal web team 



Support SEO improvements across website and landing page content, including keyword research, on-page optimization, metadata updates, internal linking, image alt text, and identifying content opportunities. 



Draft and edit marketing copy for landing pages, blog posts,
 campaigns, social posts, ads, event materials, and sales follow-up content. 



Manage and update the content calendar for LinkedIn,
, Google Business Profile,
, webinars, and other approved channels. 



Draft, schedule, and publish social media posts using approved brand guidelines, templates, and feedback. 



Create simple content assets such as social graphics, quote cards, event graphics, carousel-style posts, short-form video clips, and basic campaign visuals where possible. 



Support local visibility tasks including Google Business Profile updates, Google review campaign administration, directory listings, and chamber or partner placement coordination. 



Review web pages, forms, links, copy, layouts, and tracking details for accuracy, consistency, conversion opportunities, and SEO basics. 



Assist with blogs, case studies, testimonials, client stories, and thought leadership content tied to ALPHA IT’s core audiences. 



Support future video marketing initiatives by helping with scripts, editing short clips, captions, thumbnails, posting, and repurposing webinar or client story content. 



 



Sales Support  



Prepare sales enablement materials such as one-pagers, presentation decks, QBR visuals, proposal support slides, and follow-up
 drafts. 



Assist with prospect research for target markets including construction, trades, mechanical and field-service businesses, First Nations, non-profits, and select local government accounts. 



Support outbound and post-event follow-up coordination by preparing prospect lists, drafting
s, organizing CRM tasks, and helping the sales team keep follow-up moving. 



Help organize client-facing marketing materials such as testimonial requests, case study notes, client communication drafts, and service-awareness materials. 



Events & Partnership Support 



Support ALPHA IT’s local events, trade shows, chamber sessions, webinars, and partner opportunities from a remote coordination role. 



Help prepare event checklists, booth material lists, print collateral, registration details, shipping information, QR codes, lead-capture forms, and follow-up assets. 



Support outreach coordination to local chambers, industry associations, and community partners by preparing drafts, tracking deadlines, and organizing details for the local team. 



This role is not expected to attend local Vancouver Island events in person. 



Reporting & Optimization 



Help prepare monthly marketing and sales activity reports. 



Track practical metrics such as website traffic, form submissions, lead source,
 engagement, event leads, social engagement, Google reviews, and campaign follow-up. 



Pull and organize performance data from tools such as Mailchimp, Google Analytics, Google Business Profile, Google Ads, LinkedIn, Meta, and ALPHA CRM. 



Keep an eye on competitor activity, SEO opportunities, local market examples, and content ideas that may inform campaigns or positioning. 



What We’re Looking For 



You do not need to come from the IT industry, but you do need to be willing to learn quickly. This role is best suited to someone who enjoys execution, communication, organization, and supporting both marketing and sales outcomes. 



Excellent written English and the ability to draft clear, professional marketing and sales support content. 



Strong organization skills and the ability to manage multiple small projects, deadlines, files, and follow-ups. 



High attention to detail when reviewing copy, forms, lists, links, landing pages, reports, and campaign assets. 



Comfort working remotely with clear task briefs, project management tools, documentation, and regular check-ins. 



Ability to follow direction, work independently, ask smart questions, and communicate early when something is unclear. 



Comfort learning marketing tools, CRM systems, spreadsheets, CMS platforms, and AI-enabled workflows. 



Curiosity about technology, cybersecurity, AI, Microsoft 365, and managed IT services. 



A practical, can-do mindset suited to a fast-moving small business environment. 



Useful Experience 



B2B marketing, virtual assistant, sales support, SEO, content coordination, or demand generation support experience. 



Experience with Mailchimp or similar
 marketing tools. 



Website content coordination using WordPress or similar CMS platforms. 



Basic SEO knowledge, including keyword research, on-page optimization, metadata, internal linking, and content best practices. 



Social media scheduling, posting, engagement tracking, and content calendar management. 



Basic reporting using Google Analytics, Google Ads, LinkedIn, Meta, Google Business Profile, or similar platforms. 



Basic design or layout skills using Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, Photoshop, Figma, or similar tools. 



Experience preparing print or event materials such as postcards, rack cards, banners, tent cards, signage, or swag files. 



Video editing, captioning, thumbnail creation, or short-form video production would be considered an asset. 



Tools You May Work With 



Mailchimp, ALPHA CRM, Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint/OneDrive, Canva, WordPress or similar CMS tools, Google Analytics, Google Business Profile, Google Ads, LinkedIn, Meta, project management/task tracking tools, and AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot.

title: LSA Call Reviewer
description:
ABOUT SHOP MARKETING PROS:

We are a marketing agency based in the United States with a stateside and international team of over 50 professionals. Shop Marketing Pros is a very well-respected and rapidly growing Digital Marketing Company in the Automotive Repair Industry with strong core values and a superb track record of serving its clients better than competitors. Our key services include Website Design, Digital Advertising, Search Engine Optimization, and Social Media Management. 



Our Core Values are of incredible importance to us. We live by our “SHIELD” so please visit 
/core-values/ and familiarize yourself with our Core Values before continuing. Please continue with this job description and application if you feel you align with these values.





JOB DESCRIPTION:

Shop Marketing Pros is seeking a detail-oriented LSA Call Reviewer to join our Digital Ads team. In this role, your primary responsibility will be to listen to and rate phone calls from approximately 69 Google Local Services Ads (LSA) accounts using the Google LSA Dashboard. We utilize tracking numbers connected to GuestX, which automatically apply tags to calls. The hired candidate will review each call and accurately match the corresponding tags within the LSA Dashboard according to our established rating process. This is a highly structured and repetitive role that requires sustained focus, consistency, and attention to detail. Success depends on your ability to remain attentive, apply rating criteria consistently, and maintain accuracy throughout repetitive tasks.



The LSA Call Reviewer will directly support our Digital Ads Team in optimizing client advertising performance and assist our Client Success Team by ensuring accurate reporting. You will follow a standardized call rating scale and established workflow developed through extensive research and optimization. Comprehensive training will be provided, and the selected candidate will be expected to consistently follow the proven process already in place.





REQUIRED SKILLS:

The perfect candidate has/is:

Strong understanding of the English language (listening and comprehension)

Exceptional attention to detail and ability to follow a structured evaluation process

Extremely comfortable working with repetitive tasks

Reliable and able to meet deadlines consistently

Comfortable working independently after initial training

Access to a reliable internet connection and computer

Keen ability to stay alert and attentive to the task at hand

Ability to learn and follow already established processes and systems for call listening





JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

Listen to phone calls generated from Local Services Ads (LSAs) in the Google dashboard

Rate each call based on the standardized call rating scale provided

Match tags in the LSA Dashboard

Ensure all calls for the previous month are rated by the 6th of the following month

Collaborate with the Ads Project Manager for training, updates, and ongoing communication

Maintain accuracy and consistency in call ratings to support ad optimization and client reporting





MORE INFO, BENEFITS + PERKS:

1. This is a full-time, permanent, remote position from 8 am to 4 pm Central Time.

2. 13th Month Pay

3. Unlimited PTO (after 3 months of employment)

4. 8 Paid Holiday Leaves

5. Paid time off beginning Christmas Eve until New Year’s Day (so long as we are capable of offering it)

6. An extraordinary team/company culture





INSTRUCTIONS FOR APPLICATION:

1. Use this subject line: “SMP Call Reviewer - [Your Nickname]"

2. In your cover letter, mention which of our core values resonates with you the most.

3. Include a link to your resume.

4. Use at least 7 Apply Points to qualify for this job.

 me. Let’s keep all communication in the OLJ space.

title: AI creator/AI editor
description:
AI Ad Creative — UGC Video, AI Animation & Static Ads



We're a creative agency that produces short-form ad creative for

direct-to-consumer brands. We run a high volume of video and static ads

across Meta 
/Instagram) and TikTok for multiple clients, and we

need an AI creative who can take a brief and turn it into finished,

scroll-stopping ads — fast, and across different brand styles.



This is a hands-on production role. You'll work on several brands at once,

so you need to switch gears quickly and keep quality high under deadlines.

If you love AI creative tools and get a kick out of making ads that

actually convert, keep reading.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Edit short-form UGC video ads for Meta & TikTok (hooks, captions,

pacing, B-roll, music, sound design)

- Generate AI UGC videos using avatar tools (HeyGen or similar)

- Create AI animation / motion clips for product and explainer ads

(Veo, Kling, Runway)

- Design static picture ads and variations (Nano Banana / Gemini,

Midjourney, Photoshop, Canva)

- Adapt to each client's brand style, voice, and guidelines

- Produce multiple variations of winning ads for testing

- Add AI voiceover (ElevenLabs) and clean, readable captions

- Keep assets organized and labeled per client

- Juggle multiple brands and hit weekly output quotas



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- 1+ year editing short-form video (CapCut, Premiere, or After Effects)

- Hands-on with at least a few AI creative tools — any of: HeyGen, Veo,

Kling, Runway, Higgsfield, Midjourney, Nano Banana / Gemini, ElevenLabs

- A real eye for what makes someone stop scrolling (hooks, pacing, captions)

- Can switch between different brand styles without losing quality

- Fast, reliable, communicates every day

- Follows briefs exactly and asks questions when something's unclear

- Good written English

- A computer that can handle editing + stable internet



BONUS POINTS

- Agency or direct-response / DTC ad experience

- You can design statics AND edit video

- You know Meta Ads specs and what a winning ad looks like

- You can write your own hooks and captions



HOURS & SETUP

- Starts part-time (around 15–20 hrs/week) and grows to full-time as our

client load increases and you prove you're a fit

- This is a grow-into-it role: start small, earn more hours

- 100% remote

- Some overlap with US hours preferred



PAY

- Starting rate TBD — based on experience and hours (we'll discuss it

in the interview)

- Reviewed after 90 days + performance bonuses for ads that win



HOW TO APPLY (read carefully — we ignore copy-paste applications)

1. Change the subject line to: "I make scroll-stopping AI ads"

2. Send your portfolio or 2–3 sample ads (video and/or static)

3. List which AI tools you've actually used and what you made with each

4. Tell us in one sentence what makes a short-form ad stop the scroll

5. Tell us your expected rate to start (part-time) — per hour or per month



Applications that skip these steps won't be reviewed.

title: TRUST ELITE CLEANING SOLUTIONS VIRTUAL ASSISTANT — CLEANING BUSINESS OPERATIONS Full Time | Pacific Standard Time | Long
description:
TRUST ELITE CLEANING SOLUTIONS

VIRTUAL ASSISTANT — CLEANING BUSINESS OPERATIONS

Full Time | Pacific Standard Time | Long-Term Position



WHO WE ARE



Trust Elite Cleaning Solutions is a professional cleaning company

serving Los Angeles and the San Bernardino / Inland Empire markets

in Southern California. We handle residential and commercial

accounts. We use Jobber for all operations, Slack as our command

center, and QUO for phones. Everything runs through systems —

your job is to keep those systems moving every single day.



???????????????????????????????????????????????



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We are looking for a mature, experienced, dependable professional

with a minimum of 5 years of real work experience — ideally in

the cleaning industry, home services, or field service operations.



We need someone who has been through real workplace challenges

and knows how to handle them without hand-holding. Maturity,

professional stability, and reliability are more important to us

than anything else. If you are just starting out in your career

this is not the right position for you.



We have a small tight-knit team and are looking for someone who

will blend well with our existing team culture and take genuine

ownership of their role.



This is a long-term position with real growth opportunity.

If you show up, do the work correctly, and grow with us —

you will move up in this company. We promote from within.



???????????????????????????????????????????????



REQUIREMENTS — NON-NEGOTIABLE



You MUST meet all of the following or do not apply:



  • Minimum 5 years of professional work experience

  • Currently working or has worked in Pacific Standard Time (PST)

    business hours — 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM PST — for at least 1 year

  • Previous experience working as a VA for a cleaning company,

    home services company, or field service business

  • Knows how to use Jobber or a similar field service CRM

    such as Housecall Pro or ServiceTitan

  • Fluent in English — written and spoken — professional level

  • Reliable high-speed internet connection

  • Quiet, professional workspace at home

  • Stable work history — no job hopping

  • Available to start within 2 weeks



???????????????????????????????????????????????



TOOLS YOU MUST KNOW OR LEARN IMMEDIATELY



  • Jobber — quoting, booking, dispatching, invoicing

  • Slack — primary communication tool, you will live here

  • QUO / OpenPhone — answering calls and texts, managing inbox

  • Google LSA — responding to leads, managing the lead inbox

  • Microsoft 365 —
, SharePoint document management

  • PandaDoc — sending contracts and onboarding documents

  • Basic Zapier understanding is a plus



???????????????????????????????????????????????



YOUR DAILY RESPONSIBILITIES



Every single day you are responsible for:



LEAD MANAGEMENT

  • Monitor Google LSA inbox starting at 8:00 AM PST sharp

  • Respond to every new lead within 15 minutes of it coming in

  • Use the company pricing tool to generate accurate quotes

    every time — never guess a price

  • Follow up on all unanswered quotes within 24 hours

  • Log every lead in Slack #leads with lead ID and dollar amount



JOBBER OPERATIONS

  • Create new client profiles for every approved lead

  • Build and send quotes in Jobber using the correct templates

  • Convert approved quotes to jobs and schedule them correctly

  • Assign cleaners to jobs and confirm their availability first

  • Add complete job instructions including entry codes, parking,

    scope of work, and any special instructions

  • Monitor job status throughout the day — check-ins, completions

  • Follow up on any job that has not been marked complete on time



CLIENT COMMUNICATION

  • Respond to all client texts and calls through QUO professionally

  • Handle rescheduling, cancellations, and schedule changes

  • Escalate any client complaints to ownership immediately

  • Never discuss pricing changes or make promises without approval



SLACK ACCOUNTABILITY

  • Post your daily check-in by 8:00 AM PST every workday

  • Confirm every completed task in the assigned Slack channels

  • Respond to all Slack messages within 15 minutes during work hours

  • Post any issues, problems, or questions in the correct channel

    immediately — do not wait



CLEANER COORDINATION

  • Send job assignments to cleaners through Jobber

  • Follow up if a cleaner has not checked in within 15 minutes

    of their scheduled start time

  • Notify ownership immediately of any no-shows or problems

  • Send onboarding documents through PandaDoc to new cleaners

    and follow up until all documents are returned signed



???????????????????????????????????????????????



WHAT IS NOT ACCEPTABLE — READ THIS CAREFULLY



The following will result in immediate termination:



  • Not responding to leads within 15 minutes during work hours

  • Sending a quote with a price that was not generated from

    the company pricing tool

  • Missing the 8:00 AM PST daily check-in without prior notice

  • Not answering Slack messages during work hours

  • Making promises to clients without ownership approval

  • Logging off early without permission

  • Not logging leads, quotes, or completed tasks in Slack

  • Blaming cleaners or clients for errors that were your

    responsibility

  • Dishonesty of any kind — about tasks completed, client

    interactions, or cleaner performance



???????????????????????????????????????????????



HOURS AND SCHEDULE



  • Monday through Friday — 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM PST required

  • Saturday — 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM PST required

  • Sunday — occasional coverage may be needed

  • You are expected to be at your desk and available during

    all scheduled hours — not semi-available



This is a Pacific Standard Time role. If you cannot commit to

PST hours do not apply.



???????????????????????????????????????????????



PAY RATE



Starting rate: $4.50 to $6.00 USD per hour depending on

experience and Jobber knowledge.



Pay is weekly via Wise or direct transfer.



Performance reviews at 30 days and 90 days.

Raise available at 90 days for top performers.



???????????????????????????????????????????????



GROWTH OPPORTUNITY



We are building this company for the long term. If you are

the right person — reliable, sharp, experienced, and genuinely

good at this — there is room to grow into a senior operations

role. We promote from within. The person who earns it gets more

responsibility, more pay, and a real career path with this company.



We are not looking for someone to do the bare minimum.

We are looking for someone who takes ownership of their role

and treats this business like it matters — because it does.



???????????????????????????????????????????????



HOW TO APPLY



To be considered you must include ALL of the following

in your application or it will not be reviewed:



  1. Your full name

  2. How many years of total professional work experience you have

  3. Confirm you are available 8 AM to 5 PM PST Monday through Saturday

  4. Describe your experience working for a cleaning company or

     home services business — be specific about what you did daily

  5. List every CRM or field service tool you have used

     such as Jobber, Housecall Pro, or ServiceTitan

  6. Tell us what PST time zone hours you have worked previously

     and for how long

  7. Write this exact sentence at the top of your application

     so we know you read the entire post:

     "I have read all requirements and I meet every one of them."



Applications that do not include all 7 items will not be reviewed.



???????????????????????????????????????????????



Trust Elite Cleaning Solutions

Los Angeles, California

(818)

title: Full-Time E-Commerce Virtual Assistant – Two Openings – No Experience Required
description:
JOB TITLE: Full-Time E-Commerce Virtual Assistant – No Experience Required



We are hiring a highly dependable virtual assistant to manage the daily operations of multiple eBay and Poshmark stores. Previous e-commerce experience is not required because complete training, written procedures, and detailed task checklists will be provided.



This position is only for someone who is reliable, learns quickly, follows instructions exactly, and takes their work seriously.



WORK SCHEDULE



Work begins promptly at 6:00 AM U.S. Central Time every day.



This is not a flexible starting time. You must be clocked in, connected to the remote computer, and ready to begin working at exactly 6:00 AM.



You will continue working until all assigned daily responsibilities are completed correctly. The workload should normally take no more than eight hours, including for someone who is still learning.



The primary arrangement is for one virtual assistant to work every day, including weekends and holidays.



OPTIONAL TWO-PERSON ARRANGEMENT



If you would prefer to share the position with another reliable person, a two-person arrangement may be considered and must be approved in advance.



Under this arrangement:



One person would work four days and the other would work three days.



The following week, the schedules would switch.



Both people must complete the application and meet all requirements.



Both people must receive training and be capable of completing the job independently.



You would be responsible for coordinating the schedule and ensuring every day is covered.



Failure by either person to show up would not excuse unfinished work or leave the business without coverage.



A two-person arrangement is optional and is not guaranteed to be approved.



STRICT ATTENDANCE AND PERFORMANCE POLICY



Reliability is the most important requirement for this position.



You may be removed from the position immediately if any of the following occurs:



You are late for a scheduled shift.



You miss a scheduled shift without prior approval.



You repeatedly request last-minute schedule changes.



You disappear, become unresponsive, or stop working while clocked in.



Your internet connection is too slow or unreliable to complete the work.



You repeatedly use internet, electricity, equipment, or personal problems as an excuse for unfinished work.



You fail to communicate immediately when a genuine emergency occurs.



You are unable or unwilling to learn the assigned procedures.



You repeatedly ask questions already answered in the training materials.



You ignore instructions or create your own process instead of following the required procedure.



You repeatedly make careless or preventable mistakes.



You fail to improve after receiving corrections.



You mark tasks as completed when they were not actually completed.



You clock in without actively working.



You falsify your clock-in time, clock-out time, completed tasks, screenshots, or reports.



You leave work unfinished without reporting it.



You fail to review your work before submitting it.



You send inaccurate, inappropriate, or unreviewed messages to customers.



You share passwords, remote-access information, customer information, or business information with anyone.



You perform unauthorized actions on an account.



You work another job or perform unrelated activities while clocked in.



You are consistently too slow after receiving reasonable training and practice.



You demonstrate that you cannot independently perform the job correctly.



Serious attendance, honesty, internet, communication, or performance problems may result in immediate termination without repeated warnings.



If it becomes clear that you cannot consistently show up on time, maintain a stable connection, learn the procedures, communicate properly, or complete the work accurately, the working relationship will be ended.



Do not apply unless you are confident that you can meet these expectations.



MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES



Your daily, weekly, and monthly duties will include:



Managing daily eBay and Poshmark operations.



Checking new orders and marking orders as shipped.



Placing customer orders accurately.



Adding and verifying tracking information.



Finding orders that are missing tracking or have not shipped on time.



Checking cancellations, requests, disputes, returns, and other customer cases.



Responding to customer messages, questions, comments, and offers.



Using ChatGPT to help create professional customer responses when needed.



Reviewing every ChatGPT-generated response for accuracy before sending it.



Checking account performance and account-health metrics.



Monitoring late-shipment rates and tracking-validation rates.



Confirming that stores remain within their listing limits.



Completing product research using ChatGPT and Product Hunter.



Preparing bulk product lists.



Confirming that enough products are available for the next day’s listings.



Completing at least 100 product-research items when assigned.



Checking and responding to customer offers.



Taking screenshots of eBay and Amazon orders when required.



Following pricing, quantity, inventory, and listing-management procedures.



Confirming that shipped orders receive the required price and quantity updates.



Checking store promotions, sales, handling times, and promoted-listing settings.



Checking for duplicate listings.



Moving listings between assigned categories when instructed.



Checking negative reviews and assisting with appeals.



Completing weekly and monthly store-maintenance tasks.



Updating order sheets and other operational records.



Following the specific written procedures for every assigned account and computer.



GOOGLE SHEET TRACKING



You will use a Google Sheet to manage and document your work.



You must:



Clock in at the beginning of every shift.



Clock out only after all assigned work is completed.



Check off every task only after it is actually completed.



Complete the required tasks for every assigned account or computer.



Leave clear notes when a task cannot be completed.



Report problems immediately instead of ignoring or skipping them.



Keep the tracker accurate throughout the shift.



Never mark an incomplete task as completed.



The tracker and remote computers will be reviewed. Dishonest clock-in information, false completion marks, misleading updates, or claiming work was completed when it was not may result in immediate termination.



COMPUTER AND INTERNET REQUIREMENTS



You will use your own computer to remotely access company computers.



You must have:



Your own dependable computer.



Fast and stable internet.



The ability to remotely access company computers.



A quiet and dependable place to work.



A reliable method of communication during every shift.



A backup internet option, such as mobile data or a hotspot, is strongly preferred.



Do not apply using slow, unstable, shared, or frequently disconnected internet. Internet problems that regularly interfere with attendance or work completion may result in immediate removal from the position.



OTHER REQUIREMENTS



No previous eBay, Poshmark, Amazon, or virtual-assistant experience is required.



You must have:



Strong written English.



Basic computer knowledge.



Excellent attention to detail.



The ability to learn new systems quickly.



The ability to follow detailed written instructions.



The ability to perform repetitive tasks accurately.



Strong communication skills.



The ability to work independently after training.



The ability to remain focused until the work is completed.



The ability to accept corrections and apply them immediately.



The discipline to review your own work before marking it complete.



The ability to ask questions when genuinely confused without repeatedly asking questions already answered during training.



USE OF CHATGPT



You may use ChatGPT to improve customer messages and assist with other approved tasks.



However, you remain fully responsible for anything you send or submit. You must read, understand, and verify every response before using it.



Copying and sending an incorrect, irrelevant, or inappropriate AI-generated response without reviewing it is unacceptable.



COMMUNICATION



Training, instructions, schedule coordination, questions, task updates, and daily reporting will take place through 
, WhatsApp, or text message.



You must remain responsive while clocked in.



Account problems, unusual orders, customer complaints, technical problems, and tasks you do not understand must be reported immediately.



Silence is not acceptable. If there is a problem, communicate it before it causes unfinished work or an account issue.



WHO SHOULD APPLY



This position is suitable for someone who is:



Dependable.



Honest.



Organized.



Patient.



Detail-oriented.



Comfortable with repetitive computer work.



Willing and able to learn.



Able to follow instructions without constant supervision.



Interested in stable, long-term work.



We care more about reliability, accuracy, communication, internet quality, and the ability to follow instructions than previous experience.



DO NOT APPLY IF:



You frequently arrive late.



You regularly miss work.



You have unreliable internet.



You cannot consistently begin working at 6:00 AM U.S. Central Time.



You cannot work weekends or holidays.

HOW TO APPLY

title: Sales Representative

We are looking for a Sales Representative who can assist prospective buyers and close online ecommerce sales.

Work schedules available:

8 AM to 4 PM US EST

4 PM to 12 AM US EST

Receive incoming phone calls and live chats from potential customers (prospects) who indicated that they need shopping assistance. This does not include calls and chats from existing customers that need help with their orders (that’s a job for a different department)

Makes follow-up calls, writes follow-up
s, and text messages to potential buyers. We try to follow up 5x with each person who contacted us (unless they indicate that they are no longer interested). We don’t do cold calling. Only reaching out to prospects who interacted with our online store and left their contact information.

If not able to answer product-specific questions, conducts research in the materials provided by the supplier, or reaches out to the supplier to get the information

Outgoing, friendly, and lively

Long-term commitment - treat this as your career

Sales commission: 12% of gross profit from all orders closed. Gross profit means the sale amount minus the product and shipping costs. Paid monthly. No upper limit. Monthly commission payouts range between $1,200 (the guaranteed minimum) and as high as $3,000 (for the top performer). The average monthly payout is $1,465 (average from the last 2 years).

$1,200/month minimum guaranteed pay

Paid training on all aspects of the role

Opportunities for professional development

Friendly atmosphere

Online Interview process

title: Home Services Account Manager
description:
Ever enjoyed talking to customers, keeping schedules organized, and making sure service jobs and payments are properly followed through?



We are hiring a Home Services Account Manager to support the U.S.-based pool cleaning and repair operations team. You will help manage customer communication, service coordination, billing follow-ups, and day-to-day operational tasks that keep jobs running smoothly.



This is a support-heavy role where communication, organization, and follow-through matter. You will handle customer calls, coordinate with field technicians, manage service schedules, and assist with accounts receivable follow-ups for outstanding balances.



If you are detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast-paced service environment, this role will fit you well.



What You’ll Do

- Handle inbound calls and messages from customers regarding scheduling, service updates, and general inquiries

- Handle service and repair calls from current clients, including troubleshooting issues, rescheduling jobs, dispatching technicians, and ensuring resolution

- Assist customers with service options and basic pricing inquiries (warm inquiries only, no cold calling) 

- Follow up on outstanding balances (AR / collections outreach) in a professional and customer-friendly way

- Coordinate recurring service schedules and technician assignments to ensure timely job completion. 

- Maintain customer and job records using CRM and service tools such as HubSpot, Jobber, Skimmer, Pool Brain, or similar platforms

- Update service tickets, payment status, and job progress accurately in the system

- Support daily operations by ensuring smooth coordination between customers and technicians

- Assist in improving internal workflows, call handling processes, and documentation



\What We’re Looking For

- 3+ years of experience in customer support, account management, coordination, or service operations.

- Must have experience supporting a recurring home services business where customer accounts are actively managed over time (e.g. pool, HVAC, cleaning, roofing, landscaping, pest control, lawn care, etc.).

- Experience handling service-related phone calls and customer follow-ups.

- Experience coordinating field technicians, dispatching, or recurring service schedules.

- Experience resolving customer concerns while maintaining a positive customer experience.

- Experience in accounts receivable (AR) or collections outreach.

- Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.

- Experience using CRM or service tools such as HubSpot, Jobber, Skimmer, Pool Brain, or similar systems.

- Comfortable working with systems and learning new tools quickly.

- Proactive, reliable, and able to work independently.

- Experience working in a remote WFH setup, preferably with US clients.

- Must be available to work graveyard shifts aligned with US time zones.

title: Boomi Integration Specialist
description:
Cloudavize is a US-based Managed Service Provider (MSP) seeking a highly analytical and solution-driven Boomi Integration Engineer to join our growing team. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on connecting systems, optimizing data flows, and building scalable integration solutions across diverse platforms.



As a Boomi Integration Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing, developing, and maintaining integrations that power business operations. You won’t just be moving data, you will be architecting reliable, efficient, and secure integration ecosystems that bridge business applications and enable seamless automation.



If you are passionate about APIs, middleware, and solving complex integration challenges, we want to meet you!



Key Responsibilities:

•Integration Design: Translate business and technical requirements into scalable Boomi integration solutions.

•Development & Deployment: Build, test, and deploy integrations using Boomi AtomSphere.

•API Management: Design and consume REST/SOAP APIs and manage API integrations across systems.

•System Integration: Connect cloud and on-premise applications including CRM, ERP, and third-party platforms.

•Monitoring & Troubleshooting: Proactively monitor integrations, identify issues, and resolve errors efficiently.

•Process Optimization: Improve existing integrations for performance, scalability, and reliability.

•Documentation: Maintain clear documentation of integration processes, mappings, and system architecture.



Technologies You’ll Work With:

•Integration Platform: Boomi (AtomSphere)

•APIs & Data: REST, SOAP, JSON, XML, SQL

•Cloud & Systems: Microsoft 365, Dynamics, Salesforce, NetSuite, and other SaaS platforms

•Tools & Concepts: API Management, Web Services, Data Mapping, EDI (a plus)



What We’re Looking For:

•Proven Experience: 2–4 years of hands-on experience with Boomi or similar integration platforms.

•Integration Expertise: Strong understanding of APIs, middleware, and system-to-system integrations.

•Technical Skills: Experience with data formats (JSON, XML) and scripting where needed.

•Problem-Solving Mindset: Ability to analyze complex workflows and design efficient solutions.

•Debugging Skills: Strong troubleshooting skills for integration failures and performance issues.

•Communication: Excellent English communication skills with the ability to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.



Preferred but Not Required:

•Boomi Professional Developer or Architect Certification

•Experience with ERP/CRM integrations (NetSuite, Salesforce, Dynamics, etc.)

•Familiarity with EDI, FTP/SFTP, or event-driven architectures

•Exposure to Microsoft Power Platform or other automation tools



Why Join Cloudavize?

We believe in creating an environment where our tea
mbers can thrive both professionally and personally:

•Career Growth: Paid certifications, training, and structured onboarding

•Attractive Compensation: Competitive salary, monthly profit sharing, performance bonuses, and 13th-month pay

•Health & Wellness: Monthly healthcare allowance

•Work-Life Balance: 100% remote work with company-provided equipment

•Supportive Culture: Collaborative, innovative, and fun team environment



What Sets Us Apart?

•Performance-Based Rewards: Monthly profit sharing and bonuses

•Continuous Learning: Company-sponsored certifications and upskilling

•Collaborative Environment: Your ideas and contributions matter

•Flexibility: Remote work with meaningful, impactful projects



How to Apply:

If you’re ready to take your career to the next level as a Boomi Integration Engineer, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Virtual CIO (vCIO) – Strategic IT Consultant
description:
We are seeking a strategic and business-minded Virtual CIO (vCIO) to serve as a high-level advisor for our diverse portfolio of business clients. In this role, you will act as an extension of our clients' executive teams, bridging the gap between their business goals and their technology infrastructure.



As a vCIO, you are not just a technical expert; you are a strategic partner. You will be responsible for developing long-term IT roadmaps, managing technology budgets, overseeing risk and compliance, and ensuring that every technical investment our clients make drives measurable business value. The ideal candidate has a deep understanding of Managed Services (MSP), excellent consultative skills, and the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business strategies.



Key Responsibilities

*Strategic IT Roadmapping & Planning

- Conduct regular Strategic Business Reviews (SBRs) with clients to align technology with their 1–3 year business goals.

- Develop and maintain comprehensive IT roadmaps, including hardware lifecycle management, cloud migrations, and

security enhancements.

- Identify emerging technologies that can provide a competitive advantage or operational efficiency for specific client

verticals.

*Budgeting & Financial Management

- Assist clients in developing and managing annual IT budgets.

- Provide Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) analysis for new technology investments.

title: Director of Finance/ Financial controller
description:
We are hiring:Director of Finance/ Financial controller 



WORK FROM HOME

INTERNET ALLOWANCE

HMO

MORE EXCITING PERKS



USA BASE COMPANY 



Reports To: Chief Executive Officer (CEO)



Position Overview



We are seeking an exceptional Director of Finance to lead and oversee our offshore finance and administrative organization. This is a senior leadership position responsible for the financial health, reporting, internal controls, budgeting, cash flow, accounting operations, and executive support functions of the company.



The Director of Finance will manage a high-performing team of approximately nine professionals across Accounting, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Payroll, Human Resources, Recruiting, Compliance, and Administrative functions. This individual will work directly with the CEO, providing strategic financial guidance, operational oversight, and leadership to support the company’s rapid growth.



We are looking for a hands-on leader who can build systems, improve processes, develop people, and provide accurate financial information that drives executive decision-making.



Leadership Responsibilities



Lead, mentor, coach, and hold accountable a team responsible for:



* Human Resources

* Recruiting & Talent Acquisition

* Accounts Receivable

* Accounts Payable

* Payroll Administration

* Financial Reporting

* Administrative Operations

* Compliance

* Executive Administration



Develop a culture focused on accountability, accuracy, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.





Primary Responsibilities



Financial Leadership



* Lead all accounting and finance operations.

* Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close.

* Prepare executive financial statements and management reports.

* Manage budgeting, forecasting, and long-range financial planning.

* Develop cash flow forecasts and working capital strategies.

* Analyze financial performance and recommend improvements.

* Build executive dashboards and KPI reporting.

* Identify opportunities to improve profitability and reduce costs.



Accounting & Treasury



* Oversee Accounts Receivable, collections, and cash application.

* Oversee Accounts Payable and vendor management.

* Supervise payroll accuracy and processing.

* Manage general ledger integrity and reconciliations.

* Maintain strong internal financial controls.

* Coordinate with banks, external accountants, auditors, and tax professionals.

* Manage company banking relationships and cash management.



Strategic Planning & Reporting



* Lead the annual budgeting process.

* Prepare rolling financial forecasts.

* Monitor departmental budgets and spending.

* Present monthly financial performance reports to executive leadership.

* Develop meaningful financial KPIs across all departments.

* Provide recommendations that support business growth and profitability.





Human Resources Oversight



Provide executive oversight for:



* Recruiting and hiring processes

* Employee onboarding and offboarding

* Payroll administration

* Performance review processes

* HR policies and procedures

* Employee documentation

* Compensation administration

* Workforce planning



Compliance & Corporate Governance



* Ensure compliance with company policies and applicable employment regulations.

* Oversee business licenses, permits, insurance renewals, and corporate records.

* Coordinate with legal counsel regarding contracts, litigation, employment matters, and corporate compliance.

* Review vendor agreements and major customer contracts before execution.

* Maintain corporate governance documentation and compliance calendars.





Systems & Process Improvement



* Develop and improve Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

* Improve workflows through automation and technology.

* Strengthen internal controls and financial processes.

* Build scalable systems that support company growth.

* Drive cross-departmental efficiency and accountability.



Qualifications



* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field (CPA, CMA, or MBA strongly preferred).

* 8+ years of progressive accounting and finance leadership experience.

* 5+ years leading multi-functional teams.

* Experience managing remote or offshore teams.

* Strong knowledge of financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and internal controls.

* Advanced Excel skills and experience with ERP/accounting systems.

* Excellent analytical, leadership, and communication skills.

* Strong executive presence with the ability to influence decisions.



Preferred Industry Experience



Experience in one or more of the following industries is highly preferred:



* Commercial Services

* HVAC

* Fire Protection

* Mechanical Contracting

* Construction

* Facility Services

* Multi-location Service Businesses



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)



Financial



* Accuracy and timeliness of monthly financial reporting

* Budget performance

* Cash flow management

* Gross profit improvement

* EBITDA growth

* Financial forecasting accuracy



Accounts Receivable



* Days Sales Outstanding (DSO)

Accounts Payable

* Vendor relationships

* Performance review completion



Leadership

* Departmental KPI achievement

* Process improvement initiatives

* Cross-functional collaboration



Leadership Competencies



The ideal candidate will demonstrate:



* Executive leadership

* Strategic financial thinking

* High integrity and confidentiality

* Strong business acumen

* Exceptional organizational skills

* Data-driven decision making

* Excellent communication

* Process improvement mindset

* Ability to build and develop high-performing teams

* Accountability and ownership

* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment



As our Director of Finance, you will play a key role in shaping the financial strategy and operational discipline of a rapidly growing company. Working directly with the CEO, you will lead a talented offshore team, implement best-in-class financial systems, and help drive the company’s long-term growth and success. This is an opportunity to make a lasting impact while growing into a senior executive leadership role.

title: Creative Director, Social Media
description:
Who We Are

LEKKER Studios is a luxury real estate media company serving the NYC metro area. We work with builders, architects, brokers, and developers who compete at the top of the market. Our photography, video, and content do not look like anyone else's. That is not an a
. It is a discipline.

We are not a volume shop. We do not post for the algorithm. We build brands.



The Role

We are looking for a Creative Director who owns social media the way a brand manager owns a product line. You will manage content for LEKKER Studios and for a portfolio of our clients across Instagram, TikTok,
, and LinkedIn.

You understand that a grid is not a gallery. It is a brand statement. Every post, every caption, every reel either builds the brand or chips away at it. You know which is which before you publish.

This role is not for someone who needs direction on every decision. It is for someone who internalizes a brand deeply enough to make the right call independently, consistently, and without being reminded.



What You Will Do

For LEKKER Studios



Own the full creative direction and content strategy across all platforms

Maintain brand voice, visual consistency, and editorial standards in every post

Build and execute monthly content calendars aligned with business goals

Collaborate with the founder on campaign direction and key brand 
nts

Track performance and bring real strategic observations, not just numbers



For Our Clients



Manage 3 to 8 active client accounts at any given time

Build individual content strategies per client based on their brand identity and market position

Post daily across Instagram, TikTok, and
 with platform-appropriate content

Edit short-form video and reels from provided photo and video assets

Handle client approvals proactively. Nothing ships late. Nothing goes out wrong.





What Brand Fluency Means Here

You can look at a brand and know what it stands for before reading the bio.

You understand that a $3.5M listing in Alpine and a spec build in Ridgewood do not get the same energy, the same caption structure, or the same posting rhythm. You feel that difference without being briefed on it every time.

You know that consistency is trust. An inconsistent grid erodes brand equity quietly. You protect it.

You understand that your aesthetic does not override the client's identity. You serve the brand. Your job is to make them more themselves. Not more like whatever is trending this week.

You write captions that sound like a human being with taste and intention. Not like a prompt. Not like a template. Not like every other luxury real estate account in the tri-state area.

You know the difference between growing followers and building the right audience. You optimize for the second one.



What We Require



Demonstrated experience managing social media for multiple brands simultaneously

A portfolio that shows real creative range across different brand voices and markets

Real estate, architecture, design, or luxury lifestyle content experience strongly preferred

Strong short-form video editing skills. CapCut, Premiere, or equivalent.

Platform fluency on Instagram Reels, TikTok, and

Content scheduling experience with tools like Later, Buffer, or Planoly

Writing ability that holds up across brand voices without sounding generated

The ability to read analytics and turn them into strategic decisions, not just reports



You will be asked in the interview to analyze a brand cold and tell us what it communicates. This is not optional. It is the job.



How You Operate

You are proactive. You surface issues before they become problems. You bring ideas without being asked. You communicate clearly and briefly. You ask smart questions early and execute without hand-holding after that.

You are told something once.

You take ownership of your accounts the way a founder takes ownership of their business. Not because someone is watching. Because the standard matters to you personally.



Compensation

Competitive and commensurate with experience and portfolio quality. Growth in responsibility and compensation is real for people who perform.

To apply: DO NOT
 AS THIS IS A PRIVATE POST.  

Send your portfolio. Name three accounts you have managed in the past year and what you built there. Tell us in a few sentences why this role makes sense for where you are headed.

We're looking for a video editor who operates at that same level. Someone who understands brand, pacing, and the difference between a cut that lands and one that doesn't. Someone who knows DaVinci Resolve not as a tool but as a language.

If you need to be told what cinematic means, this isn't the role for you. If you already know, keep reading.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Edit luxury real estate walkthrough videos, cinematic listing films, and branded short-form reels

Color grade footage to match LEKKER Studios' editorial visual identity: rich, restrained, real

Cut vertical Reels and Stories optimized for Instagram and TikTok without compromising visual quality

Build and maintain branded motion graphics templates, lower thirds, and title sequences

Sync music with intent. Pacing is editorial, not automated

Work within established brand guidelines while bringing creative ideas to every project

Collaborate directly with the founder on high-profile property films and client deliverables

Manage project files, proxies, and delivery outputs with clean, organized discipline





WHAT YOU NEED



Expert-level DaVinci Resolve. Not proficient. Expert. Color, Fusion, Fairlight, Cut page, all of it

A portfolio that shows real range: narrative pacing, color work, motion design, and brand consistency

Strong understanding of luxury brand language visually and tonally

Experience editing real estate, architecture, hospitality, or lifestyle content

Ability to work with log footage, mixed color profiles, and multi-cam timelines

Clean file management habits. Organized project structure is not optional

Reliable internet, capable hardware, and a professional home edit setup

Strong communication. You can take feedback without ego and give feedback with clarity





WHAT SETS YOU APART



You've worked on short films, brand campaigns, or editorial-grade content, not just listing videos

You understand light. You know when footage is underexposed vs atmospherically dark. The difference matters

You can watch a rough cut and feel what it needs before anyone says a word

You have an opinion. You bring ideas. You push back when something isn't right

You've built motion graphics from scratch, not just dropped in templates

You know what good audio design does to a real estate film





THE WORK ENVIRONMENT

Remote. Async-first. Direct communication with the founder. No corporate layers. No committees. Fast feedback, high standards, and real creative latitude when you've earned the trust.

This starts as a project-based engagement. For the right person it grows into a core team role. We are building something with a long shelf life and we want people who want to build it with us.



COMPENSATION

Project-based or retainer, depending on volume and fit. Rates are competitive and reflect the quality of the work we expect. We don't lowball creatives. We also don't hire people who don't value their own work.

Rate discussion happens after we see your portfolio.



HOW TO APPLY

Send the following to 
 with the subject line: Video Editor — [Your Name]



Your portfolio or reel link. No PDF slideshows. Actual video.

Two to three sentences on why LEKKER Studios specifically, not just "I love real estate video"

Your DaVinci Resolve experience in plain terms. What you've done, not what you know how to do

Your availability and location



We read every application. We respond to the ones that show us you actually looked at our work.

Logo design (primary, secondary, icon versions)

Color palette, typography, and visual direction

title: WordPress Web Developer (Specifically Elementor)
description:
We're a growing UK-based digital marketing agency looking for a long-term WordPress web developer to help us build and maintain websites for our clients in the home improvement and trade industries.



We use Elementor Pro and have a proven website structure for home improvement businesses, but the design would be open for you to come up with, based on the brief if the client is specific about what they are looking for.



The right candidate will follow this structure closely and focus on delivering high-quality, accurate, and brand-aligned sites quickly and efficiently.



This role is focused on building new websites, migrating them and updating existing client sites. We provide the plugins and tools you need to build the sites, including the following:



• Elementor Pro licence

• All premium plugins (fully licensed)

• Hosting environment for development

• Access to stock image libraries

• All written content and page structure

• Ongoing training and support

• There will be no additional cost to you



What You’ll Do:



1. Set up new client sites on a development subdomain

2. Design the site inline with the client’s brief, branding, etc.

3. Move existing content from the old website to the new site

4. Add new content provided by our team

5. Use stock images (we provide access) or reuse quality images from the original site

6. Continue building new pages on a monthly basis for SEO purposes (you’ll be trained on our exact process)

7. Maintain the website each month, making small edits, etc.

8. Migrate the site from the client's existing hosting to ours when needed; set up things like Cloudflare, CAPTCHA, SMTP



Pay Structure:



1. $500 USD per website build

2. $7.50 USD per new page for ongoing monthly work (one page using our pre-built templates take less than one hour)

3. Ongoing hours (not including new website builds): 5–15 hours per week, growing over time as we onboard more clients (the goal is to get your to full-time hours)

4. $10 USD per site, per month — basic site maintenance, i.e., updating plugins, taking backups etc.

5. Additional hours paid at $7.50 USD per hour

6. As we grow, our goal is to offer you a full-time position on a monthly wage

 

Long-Term Opportunity:



This is a long-term position where hours and responsibility will increase over time. We’re looking for someone who wants to grow with us, become part of our team, and contribute to the success of a fast-growing digital marketing agency.



Over time, this role could evolve into many other technical areas within the business.



Requirements:



1. Experience building WordPress sites using Elementor Pro

2. Strong attention to detail (structure, spacing, responsiveness)

3. Ability to follow a site structure system

4. Fluent in English

4. Able to work independently and meet deadlines

5. Flexible work hours (you can work anytime from anywhere – as long as the work is completed on time and to a high standard.)?

6. Willingness to have regular Zoom calls with me so we can keep up today with work and train you on anything needed

7. Knowledge of DNS, hosting, and basic technical website tasks

8. Be responsive on WhatsApp, i.e., keep me up-to-date with the projects



Bonus Points For:



1. Familiarity with SEO basics

2. Experience working with digital marketing agencies

3. Tools We use ClickUp, GoHighLevel, Airtable (nice to have but not essential)

4. You’re up-to-date with the latest AI, such as Claude Code and you are able to help us innovate and design better ways of doing things



How to Apply:



1. In your first paragraph, include the word “kangaroo” to confirm you’ve read the full post

2. Tell us about your experience building WordPress sites with Elementor

3. Share 2–3 websites you’ve built using Elementor Pro (you will be required to show me the backend of these sites during the interview)

4. Include a short 1–2 minute video introducing yourself, upload the video to YouTube and include the YouTube link – start with “Hi Oliver” and explain why you’re a great fit

5. Let us know your availability per week and preferred working hours (in your local timezone)



Immediate Start:



We have a website that needs to be built right away, and we have lots of other websites that need to be maintained, so we will require you to be able to start immediately after the interview if you are the right fit for the role. 



As part of the interview process, you will be required to show me the backend of your example sites during the interview, so if you lie and send me websites that you have not built or are not built using Elementor, then you will not be considered for the role.



*** Only apply via this website. If you message me via

You'll come in, figure out what's working and what isn't, fix it, and then build the automations that let us scale without adding manual work. You'll also keep WordPress healthy and help us think about how our tools connect. If you live and breathe GHL and you get energy from making messy systems clean, this is your role.

GHL Ownership

Audit our current GHL setup end to end and deliver a clear picture of its health.Own ongoing GHL maintenance, cleanup, and optimization.Build, test, and maintain automations, workflows, and pipelines in GHL.Keep our GHL data clean, organized, and reliable.WordPress & Web

Maintain our WordPress site: updates, fixes, performance, and uptime.Handle small build and edit requests without breaking 
tomation & Systems Ops

Document what you build so the rest of the team can use it.Flag risks, gaps, and single points of failure before they become problems.Data & Compliance

Treat all systems that touch patient information with HIPAA and PHI constraints in mind.Build with privacy and security as a default, not an afterthought.

Must Have (Non-Negotiable)



Deep, proven, hands-on GoHighLevel experience. This is the core of the role.Strong WordPress maintenance and editing skills.

Demonstrated ability to build real automations and workflows, not just simple triggers.

Healthcare or telehealth experience, with real awareness of HIPAA and PHI constraints.

ManyChat experience.Google Workspace administration.Nice to Have

arm EHR familiarity.Experience documenting systems and building SOPs.

Benefits & Perks



Fully remote. Work from wherever you do your best work.Full-time role. US hires are W-2 employees with a benefits package and PTO. International hires are engaged as contractors or through an employer of record.Real ownership and authority over your domain. You'll own the systems, not just tickets.Mission alignment. Your work directly helps moms get lactation care when they need it.

We're hiring this role because our systems have outgrown a part-time, patchwork approach. We need one person who owns GHL and the automation layer around it so the rest of the team can move fast.



Clear communication is non-negotiable in this role. We don't currently hire in California or New York. You must be authorized to work in your country of residence.

Radical Accountability — We own our outcomes, we welcome feedback, and when someone shows us a better way, we lean in.



Competitive Greatness — The women on this team have goals and they are hungry to grow. We want people who feel the same way.

title: Real Estate Loan Processor & Deal Placement — Base Pay + Bonus on Every Funded Deal (DSCR, Fix & Flip, Construction, Com
description:
fAbout Us

We're a U.S.-based business funding and real estate lending brokerage. We help real estate investors secure financing across multiple loan types: DSCR rental loans, fix and flip, ground-up construction, and commercial deals. We're scaling our real estate side fast and need an experienced processor who can both place deals with the right lenders and process them all the way to funded.

The Role

You are the bridge AND the matchmaker. You take a real estate deal, find the right lender for it from our approved lender list and software, place it, and then process it all the way to funded. You're the single owner of the deal from lender-match to closing table.

This means two jobs in one:



Deal placement — Using our lender list and software, match each deal to the lenders most likely to fund it. Shop the deal, get terms, and place it with the best fit.

Loan processing — Once placed, process the file end to end. Manage documents, conditions, title, appraisal, and closing.



This is NOT an entry-level role. We need someone who has actually processed real estate loans before and can prove it.

What You'll Do



Shop and place real estate deals with the right lenders from our approved list using our lender-matching software

Match each deal type (DSCR, fix and flip, construction, commercial) to lenders most likely to approve and fund it

Negotiate and compare lender terms to find the best fit for each deal

Process real estate loan files end to end: DSCR, fix and flip, construction, and commercial

Act as the main point of contact between clients, lenders, title companies, appraisers, and insurance

Collect, review, and organize borrower documentation (bank statements, leases, rent rolls, purchase contracts, entity docs, etc.)

Submit complete, clean files to lenders and manage conditions through underwriting

Coordinate appraisals, title work, and closing logistics

Track every deal's status and keep the pipeline updated daily in our CRM

Own the deal from lender-match through funding — anticipate problems before they kill a deal and solve them fast



What You Must Have



Proven track record processing U.S. real estate transactions (this is required, not preferred)

Direct experience with DSCR, fix and flip, construction, or commercial loans

Experience placing or shopping real estate deals to multiple lenders (not just processing pre-assigned files)

Understanding of how title companies, underwriting, and closings actually work

Strong written and spoken English

Obsessive about details and follow-up — nothing slips

Comfortable in a CRM (we use GoHighLevel — experience is a plus)

Reliable internet, quiet workspace, able to work U.S. business hours



Bonus Points



Experience working with U.S. private/hard money lenders

Familiarity with loan origination systems or lender portals

Background as a loan processor at a mortgage company or private lender



Compensation

This role is monthly base salary plus a per-deal bonus that scales with the size of the deal. You earn your guaranteed $3.00/hour base, plus a bonus for every real estate deal you place and process to closed-and-funded status. Bigger deals pay bigger bonuses — the larger the loan you help fund, the larger your bonus.

Per-deal bonus ladder (paid when the deal closes, funds, and our fee is collected):



Under $100K funded: $15

$100K to $250K: $30

$250K to $500K: $50

$500K to $1M: $75

$1M and above: $150



Consistent funders earn a strong monthly bonus on top of base. The more deals you close — and the bigger they are — the more you make.

How To Apply

In your application, answer these four questions (applications that ignore these get deleted):



What types of real estate loans have you processed, and roughly how many deals total?

Walk me through how you'd handle a DSCR file that's stalled in underwriting because the appraisal came in low.

Have you ever shopped a deal to multiple lenders to find the best fit? Walk me through how you d
 which lender to place it with.

What CRM or loan systems have you used?
