title: Billing Operations & Accounts Receivable Specialist
description:
Role Summary

We're hiring a detail-driven Billing Operations & AR Specialist to own the full billing-to-collections cycle for a growing NEMT software company. This is a finance-focused role — not a 50/50 administrative position. Your time goes entirely to billing accuracy, getting invoices out the door, collecting what's owed, keeping the books clean, and driving the projects that make all of that run more smoothly. You'll work closely with the finance leadership, the AR team, and cross-functionally with engineering, customer success, and the systems team as we modernize our billing infrastructure.



What You’ll Do

Billing, Invoicing & Collections

• Own the monthly billing run end-to-end: generate, review, and issue customer invoices accurately and on schedule.

• Validate invoices against source data before they go out — catch pricing, date-range, duplicate-trip, and payer-configuration errors before the customer does.

• Manage accounts receivable and lead collections: track aging, follow up on outstanding balances, and drive down days-sales-outstanding (DSO).

• Process and reconcile payments, including handling voids, credits, refunds, and disputes.

• Maintain clean, reconciled AR records — cross-reference void/cleanup data so that voided or deleted invoices never linger as "unpaid."

• Serve as the point of contact for customer billing questions and disputes, partnering with customer success where needed.



Accounting & Bookkeeping Support

• Support month-end close: assist with revenue recognition, AR reconciliation, and tying out billing data to the general ledger.

• Perform bank and payment-processor reconciliations.

• Maintain accurate financial records and keep AP/AR processes running cleanly day to day.

• Help prepare schedules and supporting documentation for the finance team, fractional controller, and external accountants/auditors.

• Assist with sales-tax and exemption-certificate tracking and other recurring compliance tasks.



Billing Project Management & Process Improvement

• Project-manage billing initiatives — from migrations and system changes to new payment-rail rollouts — keeping timelines, stakeholders, and checklists on track.

• Document and continuously improve billing and collections workflows (SOPs, runbooks, controls).

• Partner with engineering and systems owners on billing-platform issues, testing, and data integrity.

• Build and maintain simple reporting on billing KPIs (AR aging, DSO, collection rate, billed vs. expected revenue) for finance leadership.

• Identify and close gaps between systems — e.g., expected-but-unbilled revenue or invoice timing mismatches.





What We’re Looking For

Required:

• 3+ years in billing, accounts receivable, collections, or a similar finance operations role.

• Strong spreadsheet skills (Excel/Sheets) and comfort working with large invoice/transaction exports.

• Demonstrated accuracy with numbers and a habit of reconciling before trusting raw data.

• Experience owning a recurring billing or invoicing cycle and managing collections directly.

• Clear written communication for customer-facing billing conversations.

• Highly organized, able to manage multiple billing projects and deadlines independently.



Nice to Have:

• Experience with SaaS or subscription billing, and/or healthcare/NEMT or other payer-based billing.

• Familiarity with billing platforms, Stripe (Billing/Connect), Salesforce, and QuickBooks or similar accounting software.

• Exposure to a billing-system migration or finance-process buildout.

• Bookkeeping coursework or progress toward a relevant certification.



How to Apply:

Please submit your application here with a direct link to your CV/Resume.

Important: To demonstrate your attention to detail, please include your favorite color in the subject line of your application message.



Note: Applications without a CV link and the correct subject line will not be considered.

title: Technical SEO Developer
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a skilled Technical SEO Developer to join our team. In this role, you will bridge the gap between development and SEO strategy — auditing websites, resolving technical issues, and collaborating cross-functionally to improve organic search performance. You will work closely with our content team and bring hands-on platform experience to deliver measurable results.

Key Responsibilities

Conduct comprehensive technical SEO audits to identify crawlability, indexability, and performance issues.

Diagnose and resolve technical issues including broken links, redirect chains, duplicate content, canonicalization errors, and structured data problems.

Implement and monitor structured data (schema markup) and validate with Google Rich Results Test.

Analyze and improve Core Web Vitals and overall page speed using Google PageSpeed Insights.

Monitor website health and search performance through Google Search Console; surface insights and take corrective action.

Partner with the content team to provide SEO guidance on content structure, internal linking, and on-page optimization.

Perform crawl-based analysis using Screaming Frog to identify site-wide technical issues at scale.

Develop and maintain SEO best practices documentation for use across technical and content teams.

Stay current with Google algorithm updates, Core Web Vitals benchmarks, and evolving technical SEO standards.



Required Qualifications

Proven experience in technical SEO, with a strong understanding of how search engine crawling, indexing, and ranking work.

Proficiency with one or more CMS platforms: WordPress, Wix, Squarespace, and/or Drupal.

Hands-on experience with Google Search Console, Google Rich Results Test, Screaming Frog, and Google PageSpeed Insights.

Solid front-end development skills (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) with the ability to implement technical fixes directly.

Ability to interpret SEO data, identify trends, and translate findings into actionable recommendations.

Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.



Nice to Have

Experience with log file analysis and server-side SEO diagnostics.

Familiarity with JavaScript SEO and rendering frameworks (e.g., React, Next.js).

Knowledge of XML sitemaps, robots.txt optimization, and hreflang implementation.

Experience using additional SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, or Moz.



What We’re Looking For

The ideal candidate is equal parts developer and SEO strategist — someone who can get into the code to fix issues but also communicate clearly with writers and marketers about how content decisions affect search performance. You are detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable owning projects from audit through implementation.

title: Civil Engineer – Land Development Due Diligence & Underwriting Review
description:
**Remote Contractor | Full-Time | US Central Time Zone**



We are seeking a detail-oriented **Civil Engineer** based in the Philippines to support our U.S.-based land development and real estate investment team. This is a full-time hourly contractor role, with compensation offered at a competitive rate depending on experience and qualifications.



The ideal candidate will have experience in civil engineering, land development, site feasibility review, and due diligence. This role requires strong attention to detail, the ability to follow established procedures, and the ability to assess land development opportunities during the early underwriting and pre-offer stages.



## Key Responsibilities



* Review the work completed by the underwriting team to ensure it follows established procedures, guidelines, and quality standards.

* Score underwriting work based on accuracy, completeness, and overall quality.

* Categorize underwritten parcels according to established internal rules and evaluation criteria.

* Conduct initial due diligence during the pre-offer phase, including review of site constraints, development feasibility, utilities, access, floodplain, zoning, subdivision requirements, and other relevant factors.

* Prepare and send offer links once deal terms have been confirmed by company principals.

* Prepare initial concept plan drawings for potential residential subdivision projects.

* Document findings clearly and consistently using company templates and systems.

* Communicate issues, risks, and recommendations to the team in a timely and professional manner.



## Qualifications



* Degree in Civil Engineering or a closely related field.

* Experience with land development, residential subdivision planning, site planning, or civil design.

* Ability to read and interpret maps, surveys, parcel data, zoning information, utility maps, and development regulations.

* Familiarity with concept planning, lot layout, road layouts, and basic subdivision feasibility.

* Experience preparing or reviewing initial concept plans is strongly preferred.

* Strong analytical, documentation, and quality control skills.

* High attention to detail and ability to follow structured procedures.

* Comfortable working remotely with U.S.-based teams.

* Strong written and spoken English communication skills. (min. C1)



## Preferred Skills



* Experience with AutoCAD, Civil 3D, QGIS, ArcGIS, Bluebeam, Google Earth, Land ID or similar mapping/design tools.

* Familiarity with U.S. land development, subdivision regulations, zoning, utilities, floodplain review, and due diligence processes.

* Ability to prepare clear summaries of site constraints, development risks, and recommended next steps.



## Work Schedule



This role requires availability during **U.S. Central Time** business hours. The position is remote and contractor-based, with full-time hourly work available.



## How to Apply



Please submit your resume and a brief summary of your experience with civil engineering, land development, subdivision planning, due diligence, and concept plan preparation. Please also include your hourly rate expectation and availability to work U.S. Central Time hours.

title: Spanish Phone Support
description:
Remote Bilingual Legal Intake Coordinator (English/Spanish) — Full Time, Long-Term



### About the Role

We are a busy U.S. law firm and we are building a 24/7 client-intake desk. When someone calls

our firm, they are often in a stressful legal situation and they need a calm, professional human

to answer — not a voi
. Your job is to be that human. You will answer calls live, return

missed calls fast, monitor messages and online forms, and make sure no potential client ever

falls through the cracks.



This is a long-term, full-time role with a stable schedule. We pay on time, every time, and we

invest in people who take ownership.



### What You'll Do Every Shift

- Answer incoming calls live through our internet phone system (GoTo softphone)

- Return every missed call with a callback attempt **within 5–10 minutes** — this is the most

  important measure of success in this role

- Monitor and respond to voi
s and text messages

- Monitor and respond to online intake form submissions (through Clio)

- Take clear intake information: caller name, phone,
, location, type of legal matter,

  urgency, and how they found us

- Enter and update every contact in our intake system so nothing is lost

- Schedule consultations on the firm calendar

- Recognize urgent matters (jail/arrest, court deadline, immigration detention, safety issue)

  and escalate them immediately using our written escalation list

- Complete a written shift handoff at the end of every shift



> **Important:** You are NOT giving legal advice. You gather information and connect people to the

> right person on our legal team. We train you on exactly what to say.



### Must-Have Requirements

- **Fully fluent in BOTH English and Spanish** — speaking, listening, reading, and writing.

  You will switch between languages on live calls. This is non-negotiable.

- Clear, warm, professional phone voice with a neutral accent in both languages

- Reliable high-speed internet **plus a backup internet source** (mobile hotspot or second

  provider) — you cannot go offline mid-shift

- A quiet, dedicated work space with no background noise

- A working computer and a noise-cancelling headset

- Strong attention to detail and great note-taking

- Comfortable using web-based software (we train you on GoTo and Clio)

- Dependable and punctual — shifts start on time, every time

- Able to work the **same fixed schedule long-term** (see Schedule below)

title: Technical Legal Writer — Patent Application Drafting (Project-Based)
description:
I am the inventor of a cryptographic key distribution architecture. I have two provisional patent applications filed with the USPTO (US 64/075,248 and US 64/094,316) that need to be consolidated into one non-provisional utility patent application.



I am looking for a technical legal writer to draft the full application. A U.S. patent agent will review your work before filing — your job is to produce a high-quality first draft that minimizes the agent's revision time.



The Work:



Draft the full specification (background, summary, detailed description, embodiments)

Draft initial claims (independent and dependent)

Create drawing/figure descriptions

Consolidate two provisional applications into one cohesive non-provisional

Ensure consistency with USPTO formatting requirements

Reference the existing provisional applications for priority claims



Materials Provided (after NDA is signed):



Both provisional applications (full text)

Technical whitepaper explaining the architecture

Working demo code (Python)

Live interactive demo

Direct access to me for questions and clarifications



Requirements:



Experience drafting patent applications (specifications and claims)

Strong technical writing skills — precise, detailed, unambiguous language

Familiarity with USPTO utility patent format and requirements

Ability to understand and describe cryptographic/computer science concepts

Attention to detail — patents require exactness

Available to start immediately and complete within 2-3 weeks



Payment Structure:



Fixed-price project: $250–$500 depending on experience and qualifications.



Payment in milestones — no upfront payment:



25?ter outline + first section delivery

25?ter full specification draft delivery

25?ter claims + drawings delivery

25?ter U.S. patent agent review



Milestone Policy:



Each milestone is a quality checkpoint. If the work doesn't meet expectations at any milestone, we'll discuss revisions first (up to 2 rounds included per milestone). If the work still doesn't meet standards after revisions, either party can end the project. You'll be paid for all completed and approved milestones up to that point.



Quality Bonus:



After my U.S. patent agent reviews your draft, you will receive a bonus based on how much revision the agent needs to make:



Minimal changes (under 10% rewritten): 50% bonus on total project price

Moderate changes (10-25% rewritten): 25% bonus on total project price

Major rewrite needed (over 25% rewritten): No bonus



Example: If your project price is $400 and the agent says the draft is clean with minimal changes, you receive a $200 bonus — total $600.



Important Terms:



This is a work-for-hire arrangement. All work product is owned by me (Olmec Technologies LLC).

NDA required before any materials are shared.

20 hours per week availability expected.



About the Invention:



The invention is a cryptographic key distribution architecture that eliminates stored keys by deriving at least one key component from the physical environment of the authorized device. Even if an attacker steals every stored component, the key cannot be reconstructed without physical access to the authorized device's environment. The architecture is algorithm-agnostic and works with any symmetric cipher.



To Apply:



Please include:



Your experience with patent application drafting (specific examples if possible)

Your familiarity with software, cryptography, or computer science patents

Your availability and estimated timeline for this project

Your expected project price within the $250–$500 range

A brief writing sample (technical or legal writing preferred)



Skills Required:



Legal

Technical Writing

Intellectual Property

title: Xactimate Repair Estimator / Insurance Reconstruction Estimator — Full-Time
description:
OVERVIEW: Evolution Restoration & Renovation is a US-based restoration and reconstruction company specializing in insurance-driven repair and rebuild projects. We work directly with carriers, TPAs, and adjusters to deliver accurate, approval-ready repair estimates.

We are looking for an experienced Repair Estimator who knows how to build complete, defensible reconstruction scopes from start to finish — drywall, flooring, cabinetry, roofing, painting, structural repairs, and everything in between. This role is repair and reconstruction only. We are not looking for a mitigation estimator.

If you have built real repair scopes in Xactimate, negotiated with adjusters, and written supplements that got approved — this role is for you. If you haven't, this role is not the right fit.

Website: 

LOCATION: Remote — Philippines

SCHEDULE: Full-Time / US Arizona Business Hours

TYPE: Long-Term with Growth Opportunity



IMPORTANT — READ BEFORE APPLYING

This is a repair and reconstruction estimating role. We will ask you to walk us through estimates you have written. We will know immediately if your experience is in mitigation instead of repair. Please only apply if you have genuine hands-on experience writing residential repair and reconstruction scopes in Xactimate.



HOW WE WORK

You will receive assignments that include:

Photos of the damage

Matterport scans (used for sketching and measurements in Xactimate)

A short report summarizing the scope of repairs needed

From this information, you will build a complete repair estimate in Xactimate and support the approval and supplement process independently.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Write complete residential repair and reconstruction estimates in Xactimate

Build accurate room sketches using Matterport scans and photo documentation

Scope all repair line items including drywall, flooring, cabinetry, paint, roofing, framing, trim, and related trades

Communicate with TPAs and adjusters to reach approved scopes of work

Prepare and submit supplements with clear justification and supporting documentation

Write structured F9 notes to justify scope and pricing decisions

Revise estimates based on adjuster feedback and carrier guidelines

Maintain organized and well-documented claim files

Create subcontractor scopes of work based on approved estimates

Support project managers by reviewing estimates and explaining line items



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

Xactimate experience writing repair and reconstruction estimates — required

Demonstrated ability to scope residential repairs across multiple trades (drywall, flooring, cabinetry, roofing, paint, structural)

Experience working directly with insurance carriers, TPAs, and adjusters

Experience handling supplements, revisions, and scope negotiations

Ability to build complete estimates independently from photos and Matterport scans

Strong written English

Strong F9 note writing and scope justification skills

Detail-oriented, organized, and able to manage multiple files at once

Ability to work independently without supervision

Looking for a long-term opportunity

This role is not for:

Mitigation-only estimators

Candidates who have only written water extraction or drying scopes

Entry-level candidates who need to be trained on Xactimate from scratch



COMPENSATION

2–3 years experience: $600 – $900/month

3–5 years experience: $900 – $1,200/month

5+ years (advanced): $1,200 – $1,600/month

Compensation depends on demonstrated experience and skill level verified during the interview process.



WHY JOIN US

Stable, long-term US client

Direct exposure to real insurance repair and reconstruction workflows

Work on real files with real approvals — not practice scopes

Opportunity to grow with a company that values estimating quality



APPLICATION QUESTIONS

How many repair and reconstruction estimates have you written in Xactimate? Give us your honest number — and be specific about whether those were repair scopes, mitigation scopes, or both.





Please share 3 repair estimates you have written. Redact client information if needed. We want to see your line items, sketches, F9 notes, and scope structure — not a summary.





Walk us through a supplement you wrote that was initially denied and then approved. What was the situation, what did you write, and what was the outcome?

title: Looking for an Elite AMV / Beat Sync Video Editor (CapCut) | Cinematic Music Video Project
description:
This is NOT your typical AMV edit.



I'm looking for a highly skilled video editor who wants to work on a cinematic music video unlike anything you've probably edited before.



While this project isn't anime, I believe the best AMV editors are uniquely qualified for it because of their attention to detail, beat synchronization, motion design, camera movement, and ability to create emotion through editing.



If you're someone who enjoys pushing your editing skills beyond standard anime edits and wants to create something visually unforgettable, I'd love to hear from you.



About the Project



The project is an original cinematic house music video called Skarnax.



The story follows a colossal, warship-sized seagull deity that descends from the heavens and attacks an isolated 1800s fishing village. As the music reaches the drop, Skarnax unleashes chaos across the sea and nearby city before mysteriously disappearing, leaving behind only one message...



He will return.



I have already created the full AI-generated storyboard and reference video.



Your job is to take the visuals to an entirely new level through professional editing.



What You'll Be Working With



I'll provide everything you need, including:



Complete AI-generated reference video

Character PNGs (multiple attack poses)

City backgrounds

Ocean backgrounds

Sky backgrounds

Flying ship PNGs

Flying debris PNGs

Crowd PNGs

Smoke, waves and environmental assets

Music track

Beat markers already synchronized to the kick drum

Additional overlay assets



You are NOT creating assets from scratch.



Your job is to transform these assets into an exciting cinematic sequence.



The Demo



Instead of asking you to complete the entire project, I first want a 5-second demo.



The demo begins at the 25-second mark of the reference video.



This is where the music drop starts.



I'll provide:



The reference video

The music

All PNG assets

Google Drive folder containing everything:







Your objective is simple:



Take those five seconds and make me say...



"I need this person editing my entire music video."



This demo is your opportunity to showcase your creativity, technical skill, and attention to detail.



What I'm Looking For



I'm not looking for someone who simply syncs cuts to the beat.



I'm looking for someone who understands how to build energy, create 
ntum, and make every beat feel impactful.



Every kick drum should feel intentional.



Every movement should feel motivated.



Every frame should contribute to the overall cinematic experience.



I'm looking for someone who understands:



Storyboard sequencing

Scene composition

Camera movement

Visual pacing

Escalation

Rhythm

Impact

Motion design

Professional transitions

Editing Style



Your editing should include techniques such as:



Advanced keyframing

Quad In / Quad Out curves

Custom easing

Smooth scaling

Position animation

Camera push-ins

Camera pull-outs

Motion blur

Overlay masking

Blend modes

Parallax

Dynamic transitions

Flash frames

Beat synchronized effects

Cinematic zooms

Speed ramps where appropriate

Layered visual effects



Every movement should feel smooth and intentional.



Nothing should feel robotic or linear.



Required Training Videos



I'll provide two YouTube videos that demonstrate the editing style and techniques I'm looking for.









Before creating your demo, I expect you to watch both videos carefully.



These videos explain many of the subtle editing techniques that separate an average edit from an exceptional one.



Examples include:



Proper keyframe easing

Motion curves

Position animation

Scaling techniques

Layer movement

Transition timing

Beat synchronization



These details matter.



Please Don't Skip the Details



Please don't submit a demo unless you're genuinely committed to reproducing the techniques shown in the reference videos.



I'm also a CapCut editor.

I understand these techniques and will immediately recognize whether they've been applied correctly.



I'm not looking for shortcuts.



I'm looking for someone who enjoys obsessing over the tiny details that make an edit feel professional.



I'd rather review five exceptional demos than fifty rushed ones.



Let's respect each other's time.



Creative Freedom



I don't expect you to copy my AI storyboard exactly.



You're welcome to improve it.



You're welcome to combine the AI-generated video with the PNG assets if you think it creates a stronger result.



If you have a better visual idea that improves the sequence while staying true to the story, I'm happy to see your creativity.



The goal isn't to follow instructions blindly.



The goal is to create the most exciting sequence possible.



Experience



Great work always speaks louder than the number of years you've been editing.



If your demo impresses me, that's what matters most.



How to Apply



Please start your application with the following:



1. Your experience level



Example:



I have 12 years of professional video editing experience.



or



I have 5 years of experience, but I believe my work demonstrates the level you're looking for.



2. Links to your best work



Please send only your strongest edits.



Quality is much more important than quantity.



3. Confirm you've watched both YouTube reference videos.

4. Download the project assets from the Google Drive folder below.



Google Drive:





I'm looking forward to seeing what you create.

Position Overview



This is not an easy job. We want to be upfront about that.



You’ll be the first point of contact with homeowners who are often dealing with difficult, stressful, or emotional situations—pre-foreclosure, inherited properties, code violations, non-paying tenants, divorce, etc. Many of them won’t want to talk, some will hang up, some will get frustrated, and some will be openly rude.



To succeed here, you must have thick skin, steady emotions, and the ability to stay calm, professional, and consistent no matter how the conversation goes.



This role requires high volume calling, high volume texting, accurate data entry, and the ability to follow a proven script while still sounding like a real human. If you’re able to build rapport quickly, stay organized, and push through rejection without losing energy—this position can become long-term with real opportunity.



Responsibilities

Cold Calling (Primary Duty)



Make 150–300 outbound calls per day to distressed property owners (auto-dialer provided).



Follow structured sales scripts while adapting naturally to real conversations.



Overcome objections and keep the conversation moving toward setting an appointment.



Identify motivation, timeline, condition of the property, and selling situation.



Take detailed notes in the CRM after every call—accuracy is critical.



Handle hang-ups, rejections, and tough conversations with professionalism.



SMS Text Campaign Management



Run daily and weekly SMS outreach campaigns to homeowners using our texting platform.



Manage replies quickly and professionally—responding to objections, questions, or hostility in a calm, consistent tone.



Tag and sort leads based on replies (cold, warm, hot, not interested, follow-up later, etc.).



Follow up on SMS leads by phone when needed.



Maintain perfect grammar, clarity, and compliance in all text communication.



Lead Qualification & Appointment Setting



Determine whether someone is a viable lead by asking the right questions.



Schedule appointments for the Acquisition Manager based on seller motivation.

title: Appointment Setter (Clear US Accent Required): Warm Bathroom Remodeling Leads: Extremely High Earning Potential
description:
We run ads for bathroom remodeling companies across the US. Leads click our ad, get fully qualified, and are told someone will call them. Your job is to call them fast, run a short script, and book them on our client's calendar. That's it.

These are warm leads. They just raised their hand and they're expecting your call. You are not cold calling anyone.

We're looking for a killer. Someone who shows up to dominate, hits the phone hard, and wants to book as many appointments as possible because every booking is more money in your pocket. If you're the type who's happy doing the bare minimum, this isn't for you. If you're hungry and want to earn, keep reading.

What you'll do:



Watch a Slack channel during your shift for new lead notifications

Call the lead within 5 minutes of the notification (speed is the whole game here)

Open the right client's CRM, go to the Opportunities tab, hit call

Follow the script (it's in the CRM and in Slack)

Re-qualify and book the appointment on the client's GHL calendar

Done



The script and everything you need is provided. You are not building anything or figuring anything out. You call, follow the script, book.

What we need:



A clear American accent. This is non-negotiable. You're calling US homeowners and they need to feel comfortable on the phone. If there's any noticeable accent, this isn't the right role for you.

Real sales or phone experience. You can hold a conversation, handle a little hesitation, and get someone on the calendar.

A closer mindset. You want to win, you want the commissions, and you treat every lead like money on the table.

Reliable and fast. When a lead comes in, you're on it inside 5 minutes.

Good internet and a quiet place to call from.



Pay:



$7.50 for every appointment you book

We expect a booking rate of at least 35% of the leads you call. Leads are warm and the script works, so the more you grind, the more you earn. No cap.



We're starting slower, around 5 to 15 leads a day to call, and it's ramping fast. So I'm not looking for someone just to fill a seat. I need someone who is ready now, has the experience, and wants to be here a while and grow with us as the volume climbs. You'll handle leads across all our clients from one seat, so we want someone who can own it. We're hiring one person right now.

To apply:



Send a 60 to 90 second voice note. This is required. No voice note means you will not be considered at all, no exceptions. It's how we hear your accent and how you'd actually sound on the phone with our leads, so make it good.

After the voice note, the next step is a quick 5 minute call where I'll gauge your ability. If it's a fit, we onboard you fast and get you into the flow right away.

We move quick here, so if you're ready to start earning, send that voice note now.

About the Role

You'll have access to an expert Google Ads contractor for roughly 8 hours a month for the highest-stakes decisions or second opinions — but the accounts are yours to run.



What You'll Own

Communication & Reporting

Produce monthly performance reports tying ad spend directly to leads, calls, and revenue impact

Flag risk early — if a budget is pacing wrong or a campaign is underperforming, we hear about it before it becomes a bigger problem



Strategic Budget Ownership



Responsibly manage real client ad spend — this role carries direct accountability for driving strong ROAS, not just "keeping campaigns running"

Know when something is within your judgment to fix immediately, and when to escalate to our Google Ads contractor for expert input

Continuously look for opportunities to scale spend profitably as accounts prove out



What We Need From You



Proven, hands-on experience managing Google Ads accounts for real clients — not just a certification, actual campaigns you've built and managed

Strong understanding of Search campaigns and Performance Max; Local Service Ads experience is a bonus, not required

Experience managing meaningful ad budgets with real accountability for results

Comfortable auditing someone else's account and clearly identifying what's wrong and how to fix it

Strong communication skills — able to explain ad performance in terms a non-technical business owner understands

Detail-oriented with conversion tracking, UTM parameters, and tying spend to actual business outcomes

Self-directed — you should be able to run your accounts without needing daily oversight

Comfortable working US business hours for client and team communication

Work on ecommerce clients on google ads

 ads for local contractor or agencies like ours



Schedule & Pay



Hours: Full-time, 40 hours/week

Base Pay: $1,500–$1700/month, based on experience

Bonuses for: client retention, account performance/ROAS results, and successful new account builds



How to Apply

Your resume/CV

WHY YOU STAND OUT FROM OTHERS - tell me in the application

A short note on a time you caught a major problem in an ad account (yours or someone else's) and how you fixed it

title: After Effects Motion Graphics Editor for YouTube (Kinetic Typography + Fast Turnaround)
description:
After Effects Motion Graphics Editor for YouTube (Kinetic Typography + Fast Turnaround)



The role



We are a video editing company working with a roster of YouTube creators and brands, and we are looking for an After Effects specialist who lives and breathes kinetic typography and retention-style motion graphics. If you can make text snap, fly, bounce, and hit on the beat, and you can do it fast without losing quality, keep reading.



You will work across multiple clients and a range of project types, so range matters. That said, one of our primary clients does high-energy retention-style content, and that work will be the bulk of your day to day. The benchmark below shows exactly what that looks like.



This is the bar (watch before applying)



Watch the first 1 minute and 43 seconds of this video. This is the style of our primary client and the bulk of the work you will be doing. This is the level of editing and motion graphics you need to be able to hit:



**
**



Pay attention to how the text animates onto the screen word by word in sync with the speaker, how key words get scaled up, highlighted, underlined, or boxed for emphasis, how the camera punches in and zooms on important 
nts, and how every animation hit is matched with a sound effect. That rhythm and polish is the standard. If you cannot produce work at this level, this role is not the right fit.



What you will be doing



- Editing YouTube videos with heavy motion graphics and animated text

- Building snappy kinetic typography (text floating in, scaling, sliding, word-by-word emphasis)

- Quick zoom-ins, punch-ins, and energetic transitions cut to the audio

- Animated text treatments: underlines, highlights, callouts, lower thirds, on-screen labels

- Mixing typography styles and treatments to match the energy of each 
nt

- Layering sound effects and syncing animation hits to the beat



Must-haves



- **Expert-level After Effects.** This is non-negotiable. You should be able to animate text and graphics fluidly without hunting through tutorials.

- **Strong kinetic typography portfolio.** Show us animated text you personally built, not work you assembled from templates.

- **Fast, reliable turnaround.** You ship polished work on tight deadlines and you hit your dates.

- **A sharp eye for timing, pacing, and sound design.** You know why a cut lands and where a sound effect belongs.

- **Range and adaptability.** You can match different client styles and brand guidelines, not just one look. Reference videos and brand kits should be something you follow closely, not override.

- **Premiere Pro familiarity** for the base edit and assembly.

- **Clear written English and good communication.** You ask smart questions and you do not go quiet mid-project.



Nice to have



- Thumbnail design or Photoshop skills

- Experience working with an agency or juggling multiple clients at once

- Experience in a specific niche (tell us what kind of content you have edited)

- Familiarity with fast-paced, retention-style creator editing (think the energy of Hormozi, MrBeast, or Gadzhi style channels)



How we work



For each project we give you the raw footage, a clear direction, reference videos, and the client's brand guidelines. You bring the energy and the polish, and you match the look the client expects. You will move between clients and project types, so being organized and able to switch gears matters. We value speed, consistency, and someone who makes the work better without needing to be micromanaged.



Because we are an editing company with an active client roster, this is steady, ongoing volume, not one-off gigs. Volume is typically at least 2 videos per week and often more. This is a long-term role for someone who wants to become one of our go-to editors as we grow.





## Hours and availability



This role runs on US business hours. We need you online and reachable during the Central Time workday, roughly 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM CST (US Central Time). You do not have to cover the whole window, but you should be able to commit to a consistent block inside it so we can send feedback, answer questions, and turn revisions around same day.



Please note: these hours are an overnight shift in the Philippines (roughly 8 or 9 PM to 7 or 8 AM your time, depending on the season). Only apply if you are comfortable working nights consistently and on time.



Pay



$15 to $25 per hour depending on speed and skill, with room to grow for the right person. We pay well and on time for great work.



How to apply (read carefully, this is how we filter)



1. Start your message with the word **SNAP** so we know you read the whole post.

2. Send your reel or portfolio. Include 2 or 3 timestamps pointing to kinetic typography or animated text you personally created, and tell us exactly what you did on each.

3. In one or two sentences, tell us the fastest you have ever turned around a fully edited, motion-heavy YouTube video and how long that video was.

4. Tell us honestly: can you produce work at the level of the benchmark video above? If you have something in your reel that comes close to that style, point us to it.

5. List the software you use, the hours you can be online in CST (US Central Time), and your weekly availability.



Generic messages with no reel will not be considered. We are hiring one great person, and the right fit will have steady, long-term work with us.

description:
The Demand Generation Specialist will be responsible for creating, executing, and optimizing multi-channel marketing campaigns that generate high-quality, sales-ready leads (MQLs) and accelerate pipeline growth. This role requires a strong blend of analytical skill, creative campaign execution, and technical marketing expertise within a complex B2G/B2I sales environment. The ideal candidate has 3+ years of hands-on experience in an agency environment, primarily managing the technical execution of demand generation campaigns in a B2B environment, with a demonstrable track record of improving MQL velocity and quality. This is a Full-Time Remote based role.



Responsibilities & Duties

Campaign Deployment: They are responsible for the hands-on building and launching of all lead generation campaigns.

Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO): They own the testing and optimization of all conversion points—landing pages, forms, and calls-to-action (CTAs). By improving conversion rates by even a few percentage points, they can instantly boost lead volume without increasing ad spend, directly accelerating lead generation efficiency.

Budget Efficiency: They manage the day-to-day bidding and targeting in advertising platforms, ensuring the budget is spent on high-performing segments and channels, which lowers the Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) and makes growth more sustainable.

MarTech Management: They manage the technical connections between advertising platforms such as LinkedIn, Google and our source of truth (HubSpot). This ensures reliable data flow, preventing "leaks" in the funnel where valuable leads might be lost.

Lead Nurturing Mechanics: They build, test, and segment the automated
 nurture tracks, ensuring MQLs who aren't yet sales-ready remain engaged with relevant, value-driven content until they show enough intent for a sales handoff.

Lead Follow up: Proactively follow up with new prospects after a webinar and after new prospects have connected with the S2C team at an event.

Reporting: Ensure accurate reporting of new leads and conversations generated.

Audience Segmentation: They execute precise audience targeting based on defined Ideal Customer Profiles (ICPs)(e.g., industry, revenue, size, specific titles, existing technology).

Other duties as assigned.



What Success Looks Like

Pipeline generation meets/exceeds goals, becomes more consistent, measurable, and repeatable

The expectation will be to generate 50 net new leads per week, or 200 net news leads per month (you d
 on channel mix)

Marketing and Sales operate with clearer handoffs and strong alignment

HubSpot reporting becomes more trusted and actionable

Messaging and campaigns become sharper, more strategic, and more effective

Leadership gains better visibility into what marketing is contributing and where to invest next
